entries.decision: Canonize adel as neutral sibling root. This August 10 author-approved choice was omitted from the saved lexicon; explicitly restored by author October 24, replacing obsolete frat.
entries.origin: Author-confirmed choice, original ChatGPT conversation 2026-08-10 16:11:23 UTC; restored at author's instruction 2026-10-24

entries.decision: Canonize adele = female sibling/sister, derived from neutral adel plus kinship-family ending -e. Do not generalize this pattern to unconfirmed kinship candidates.
entries.origin: Author-confirmed 2026-08-10 adel + -e feminine sibling formation; restoration 2026-10-24

entries.decision: Canonize adelgen = sibling of a parent. Composition A+B means A relative to B, keeping left and right relation roles distinct.
Canonize adelo = male sibling/brother, derived from neutral adel plus kinship-family ending -o. Replaces retired frat. Not evidence of a universal gender rule across all nouns.
entries.origin: Author-confirmed 2026-08-10 adel + -o masculine sibling formation; restoration 2026-10-24

entries.decision: Canonical root for air. Preserves the classical/international aer- family in canonical Unisermo spelling.
Canonical transparent compound aer+plan for airplane/aeroplane. Preferred over aeroplan; the lexical structure is explicitly aer + plan.
entries.origin: productive compound aer + plan; international aeroplane family

entries.decision: Canonical replacement for legacy act.

Canonical water root. Chosen as akwa rather than akva or akua: w represents the canonical /w/ glide, preserving the international aqua /akwa/ shape without substituting /v/ or introducing a vowel hiatus.

Use alor for THEN in condition-consequence constructions, distinct from ergo inferential THEREFORE. Not obligatory by this lexical ratification; its precise omission rules and nested scopes await detailed conditional syntax.
entries.origin: Explicit author ratification 2026-10-24; Italian allora and French alors

entries.decision: Canonical vertical-axis root for high/upper/up. With allative -ad, altad marks upward direction/toward a higher position. It may compound transparently with mov: altmov = ascend/go up.
Canonical transparent motion compound alt+mov for upward motion/ascending. Equivalent directional paraphrase: mov altad. It is distinct from phase-derived admov, which means begin moving.
Canonical vertical-axis root for low/lower/down. With allative -ad, basad marks downward direction/toward a lower position. It may compound transparently with mov: basmov = descend/go down.
Canonical transparent motion compound bas+mov for downward motion/descending. Equivalent directional paraphrase: mov basad. It is distinct from phase-derived demov, which means cease moving.
Canonize bisjergen = two successive gen (parent) relations: parent of parent. bisjer counts two relational steps. No claim that bisjergeno/bisjergene have resolved male/female endpoint scope.
entries.meaning_it: nonno o nonna (genitore di un genitore, neutro)
entries.origin: 2026-08-10 original genealogical NUMjer design, author reaffirmation 2026-10-24

entries.decision: Canonical replacement for legacy dec.
Canonical verbal root replacing legacy dict; regular participial/resultative dikit.
Canonical replacement for legacy direct.

Canonical replacement for legacy doc and former dots. Source Latin docere means teach; Latin doctor is its agent noun. The k adaptation preserves the doc-/doct-/doctor family transparently under the canonical alphabet, giving regular dok + -or -> dokor (teacher).

Canonical invariant free causal relator, pronounced with canonical hiatus /du.e/. Former suffix -due is retired. Author ratified on 2026-10-24 extension to complete causal clause in both P due Q and due Q, P, distinct from inferential ergo.
entries.meaning_it: a causa di; perché/poiché/siccome (introduce anche una proposizione causale)

entries.decision: Canonical replacement for legacy ekual. With current w=/w/, canonical pronunciation is /e.kwal/.
Use ergo to introduce inferential conclusions, distinct from conditional-correlative alor and ordinary adversative ma.
Concessive conjunction allowing etsi P, Q and Q etsi P. Factual or contextually accepted P contrasted with Q; hypothetical even-if semantics remain unresolved.
entries.meaning_it: sebbene, benché, nonostante il fatto che

entries.decision: Canonical fused invariant compound etsi+se = hypothetical EVEN IF. Unlike factual concessive etsi, this construction does not assert the truth or falsity of P. Both etsise P, Q and Q etsise P are accepted. Not a general license for arbitrary connective fusion.
entries.origin: Explicit author ratification 2026-10-24; compound etsi + se

entries.decision: Canonical replacement for legacy fac.
Canonize fil as the inverse one-generation relation to gen: offspring/child of a parent, irrespective of age or sex. It does not mean a young person.
entries.meaning_en: offspring; child of a parent (relational, gender-neutral)
entries.meaning_it: figlio o figlia in quanto discendente diretto; prole
entries.origin: Direct author ratification, 2026-10-24; prior kinship design discussion

entries.decision: Canonical transparent kinship compound filadelgen = fil + (adel + gen), offspring of parent's sibling = first cousin. Components compose as A relative to B and are evaluated from right to left. Not a gender-specific or more distant cousin.
entries.meaning_en: first cousin (offspring of a parent's sibling, gender-neutral)
entries.meaning_it: cugino o cugina di primo grado (figlio o figlia di uno zio/zia)
entries.origin: Productive relational composition fil + adel + gen following direct approval of fil, 2026-10-24

entries.decision: Canonical invariant free purposive relator. Former suffix -fin is retired.
Canonize gen as neutral parent relation, base for geno (father) and gene (mother).
Canonize gene = mother, female parent. Sex suffix applies to the immediate parent relation in this confirmed form.
Canonize genegene = gene + gene: mother of mother; trace relational path from ego right to left. Explicit link sex is part of each parent root, not a floating word-final gender suffix.
entries.origin: Author-requested genealogical path feature, 2026-10-24; compose gene + gene

entries.decision: Canonize genegeno = gene + geno: mother of father; traverse rightmost geno (father), then leftmost gene (his mother).
entries.origin: Author-requested genealogical path feature, 2026-10-24; compose gene + geno

entries.decision: Canonize geno = father, male parent. Sex suffix applies to the immediate parent relation in this confirmed form.
Canonize genogene = geno + gene: father of mother; traverse rightmost gene (mother), then leftmost geno (her father).
entries.origin: Author-requested genealogical path feature, 2026-10-24; compose geno + gene

entries.decision: Canonize genogeno = geno + geno: father of father; both links specify male parent. Not a general label for all grandfathers.
entries.origin: Author-requested genealogical path feature, 2026-10-24; compose geno + geno

entries.decision: Ratify giga as the numerical power 1000000000 (short-scale billion, Italian miliardo), with a fused 1..999 group coefficient, not as an abbreviation gig.
entries.origin: Author ratification 2026-10-24; international giga- power prefix

entries.decision: Canonical replacement for legacy cad.
Canonical replacement for legacy cap.
Canonical WH-word WHY, replacing legacy kur to avoid collision with the care/cure lexical family.
Canonical numeral 5 replacing legacy cin.
Canonical replacement for legacy clar.
Canonical WH-word HOW. Retained after moving Latin cum/com- lexical root to kun.
Canonical replacement for legacy cred.

Canonical replacement for legacy/source com from Latin cum/com-. Chosen as kun to avoid collision with canonical question word kom = HOW. Also canonical invariant free comitative relator in kun + noun phrase; the former comitative suffix -ko is retired.
Canonical replacement for legacy/source cur from Latin cura. Chosen as kurar to avoid collision with the former WHY question word; WHY is now ker.
Canonical replacement for legacy loc.
Use standalone ma as ordinary adversative BUT, distinct from simple additive e. Concessive subordinate connectors remain open.
entries.origin: Explicit author ratification 2026-10-24; Italian ma, French mais and Portuguese mas

entries.decision: Keep spelling major. Under the current alphabet j is the glide /j/, so canonical pronunciation is /ma.jor/, not legacy /madzh-or/.
Ratify mega as the numerical power 1000000, with a fused 1..999 coefficient before it, omitting uno for multiplier 1 and omitting zero groups.
entries.origin: Author ratification 2026-10-24; international mega- power prefix

entries.decision: Ratify mila as the sole current numerical power 1000; explicitly retire historical mil as noncanonical. Group coefficient 1..999 precedes mila, omitting uno for coefficient 1. Composites remain fused.
entries.origin: Author ratification 2026-10-24; replaces historical mil; internationally recognizable mila/mille

entries.decision: Canonical invariant free manner relator. Former suffix -mod is retired.
entries.meaning_it: nel modo di; alla maniera di

entries.decision: P nam Q indicates that the speaker presents Q as support for asserting P, without claiming that Q caused P or that Q proves P. Distinct from factual causal due and inference-first ergo.
entries.meaning_en: for/indeed; introduces an evidential or argumentative reason supporting an assertion
entries.meaning_it: infatti; introduce una giustificazione o evidenza per un'affermazione

entries.decision: Canonical replacement for legacy nacion.

Canonical force/manner verb for push. It describes exerting force in a pushing relation and does not by itself entail successful displacement; actual caused motion is expressed by the mov-family valency frame.
Canonical invariant free instrumental/perlative relator. Former suffix -per is retired.
Canonical root for plane/flat/level. Used as the second component of transparent compound aerplan.
entries.origin: Latin planus / planum; international plan-/plane family

entries.decision: Canonical invariant free benefactive relator. Former suffix -pro is retired.
entries.meaning_it: a favore di; per il beneficio di

entries.decision: Ratify standalone se as IF, distinct from confirmed si YES and no NO/NOT. No automatic ratification of then/tum, ergo, nisi, sin, sed or other connective forms.
entries.origin: Explicit author ratification 2026-10-24, Latin si adapted to distinguish si=yes

entries.decision: Canonical replacement for legacy centr. The bare root sentr is preferred over former sentrum to preserve a compact derivational base and avoid an unnecessary nominal ending.
Canonical replacement for legacy cert.
Canonical replacement for legacy circul. User-supplied sircul is normalized to sirkul because c is not in the canonical alphabet.
Canonical replacement for legacy civ.
Canonical replacement for legacy spec.
Canonical replacement for legacy struct.
Canonical invariant free temporal relator. Former suffix -tem is retired.
Canonical force/manner verb for pull. It describes traction/pulling and does not by itself entail successful displacement; actual caused motion is expressed by the mov-family valency frame.
entries.origin: Latin trahere / tract-; international traction-tractor family

entries.decision: Canonical human/person root replacing earlier om. Optional referential specificity gives umano (male person/man) and umane (female person/woman); explicit plural is wi uman. Abstract humanity is regularly umanitat via -itat.
Canonical replacement for legacy voc.
